blinding_guess.why: All six headers are installed at this revision under include/gazebo-1.9/gazebo/<subdir>/, and the installed pkg-config CFlags still add -I.../gazebo-1.9/gazebo, so the element paths (common/Time.hh, physics/physics.hh, ...) resolve for consumers. Only visible risk is platform-specific: the generated common.hh, physics.hh and sensors.hh are installed into the same directories as Common.hh, Physics.hh and Sensors.hh, which would collide on a case-insensitive filesystem; that is not a defect on the Linux/ROS 1 target.

notes: All six packet elements are C++ header APIs (side provides); none is a topic/service/action/message, so msg_type, frame, units, QoS (ROS 1: null), rates and definition_id are null (definition_hash.py kinds msg/srv/action/idl do not apply to a header). Declaration signature convention: for each header the verbatim CMake install rule that places it at <INCLUDE_INSTALL_DIR>/<element path>, where INCLUDE_INSTALL_DIR is "include/gazebo-${GAZEBO_VERSION}/gazebo" (snapshot:CMakeLists.txt:87; GAZEBO_VERSION 1.9 from snapshot:CMakeLists.txt:13-14,20).
